name: DOUBLE
source:
Near future. Winged descendants of angels and demons have appeared on the Earth. A series of crimes break out in the capital Chiba City. Main character is a student who attends Chiba Defense Academy ADAMAS. One day he meets an angelic girl at a crime scene...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
不远的未来，拥有羽翼的天使与恶魔后裔出现在地球。首都千叶市接连发生多起犯罪。主人公是千叶防卫学院ADAMAS的学生。一天，他在犯罪现场遇见了一名天使般的少女…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-may-2001-sapphism-no-gensou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
